audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart said Illaoi at 2+ items while whys[6], spikes[3] and late all say Kassadin outscales hard; packet levelChart row 7 is Kassadin. Level 6 was 'Skill' while every prose string says the level-6 all-in still favours Illaoi, and the mirror recorded earlier stages left with Illaoi.
audit.why: Emerald+ 51.54% over 879 games with a hard early lead and a hard late fall-off. Packet chart is Illaoi x6 then Kassadin.
audit.corrected: Level 6 -> Illaoi in both layers; 2+ items -> Kassadin in both layers. Ratings moved with them.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cooldown advice was vague ('his mobility spike at 6').
audit.why: Riftwalk is 500 range, 5/3.5/2s, 40 mana plus escalating stacks; Null Sphere is 9/8.5/8/7.5/7s; Harsh Lesson is a flat 4s. Real numbers make the engage window concrete.
audit.corrected: Riftwalk's 500-range, 5s-at-rank-1 blink and Null Sphere's 8s shield window written into the do's and the mid block.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page implied Riftwalk lets Kassadin escape Test of Spirit, and never mentioned Nether Blade's auto-attack reset.
audit.why: Riot's Test of Spirit text: 'If killed, OR IF THE TARGET GETS TOO FAR FROM THE SPIRIT, the target will become a Vessel.' Blinking off the leash is the worst outcome for Kassadin, not an escape. Nether Blade carries the autoReset flag, so his burst opens on an auto wind-up.
audit.corrected: Riftwalk cannot break the leash — leaving the spirit makes him a Vessel; Nether Blade wind-up named as the burst tell.

edits.before: Even after he gets R Riftwalk, your R Leap of Faith and a landed E Test of Spirit can kill him before he stacks enough Riftwalks to escape — his early blinks are short and mana-costly.
edits.after: Riftwalk cannot escape Test of Spirit — leaving the spirit turns him into a Vessel and spawns tentacles on him. He must kill it in place, so Leap of Faith lands on a Kassadin who cannot run.

edits.before: Levels 3-6 stay firmly in your favor: keep walking him down while his Q Null Sphere shield is on cooldown, and even his level-6 Riftwalk can't save him from a landed E plus R burst.
edits.after: Levels 3-6 are yours: walk him down while Null Sphere's shield sits on its 8s cooldown, and Riftwalk cannot save him from a landed Test of Spirit — blinking off the spirit only makes him a Vessel.

edits.before: Punish him relentlessly pre-6 with W Harsh Lesson while his Q shield is down
edits.after: Punish pre-6 with Harsh Lesson (4s) the moment his Null Sphere shield is spent

edits.before: His mobility spike at 6. Kill him before it scales. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Riftwalk is a 500-range blink, 5s at rank 1. Engage when he has spent it or is low on mana.

edits.before: Track Kassadin's Riftwalk: His mobility spike at 6. Kill him before it scales. When it is down — Land E, slam the spirit.
edits.after: His combo opens with a Nether Blade auto reset — step on the wind-up. Riftwalking away from your spirit only turns him into a Vessel.

notes: Level-chart rows proposed as matched full/content pairs. The Riftwalk-cannot-escape-the-leash fact is restated from the kassadin__illaoi mirror audit, same fact from Illaoi's side.
